name: GymSinglePool depositFromOtherContract missing access control
summary: GymSinglePool.depositFromOtherContract() is external with no caller authorization and its private _autoDeposit() helper never pulls tokens from anyone: it only credits userInfo/user_deposits for the caller-supplied _from address and makes the pool approve itself for the credited amount. Any address could therefore book an arbitrary GYMNET deposit it never funded and then call withdraw(), which transferFrom's the fabricated principal out of the pool's own GYMNET balance.
notes: The eighth and last Upgraded event the proxy emitted before the exploit, log 218 of block 18431003, selected implementation 0x0288fba0bf19072d30490a0f3c81cd9b0634258a; the EIP-1967 implementation slot still holds that address at block 18498608 and its runtime code hash is unchanged from its deployment block 18430866 through the exploit.

Eighteen transactions between blocks 18498635 and 18501349 move 40,190,625.461200003991892805 GYMNET out of the pool proxy 0xa8987285e100a8b557f06a7889f79e0064b359f2 to twelve attacker addresses: six fabricated principals of 8,000,000, 8,000,000, 8,000,000, 8,000,000, 8,000,000 and 180,000 GYMNET, one of 10,000 GYMNET, and eleven small claimAll payouts on the fake positions. The pool's GYMNET balance falls from 40,170,632.720222770254498215 before the campaign to 1,847.531967313247850203 at block 18501360. The attacker unwound essentially all of it through the PancakeSwap GYMNET/WBNB pair in eight transactions and the exploiter EOA received exactly 7,475.416854059780883755 BNB; only 625.251209 GYMNET was left stranded in three spent exploit contracts. Those realised proceeds, valued at the DefiLlama BNB observation nearest the incident timestamp (289.5921948984552 USD), give the USD figure and the implied 0.0538638637668875 USD per GYMNET unit price. Marking the drained tokens at DefiLlama's GYMNET spot of 0.19653195097164186 USD would give 7.90 million USD, but the drained quantity is about 2.6x the pair's entire GYMNET reserve and was not realisable at that price; contemporaneous reporting of roughly 2.1 million USD is the realised figure. The 10 percent GYMNET transfer tax charged on the attacker's sells is already inside the realised proceeds. Nothing was returned by the attacker: the BNB was swapped and bridged out over the following day.
